title: Pair Sum Indices
prompt:
You are given a list of integers nums and an integer target. Exactly one pair of distinct positions i < j satisfies nums[i] + nums[j] == target. Return that pair as a list [i, j] with i < j.

You may not use the same position twice. Aim for a single pass over the list.

Example:
  pair_sum_indices([4, 9, 1, 6], 7) -> [2, 3]   (1 + 6 = 7)
